title: Narrowband Receive Array
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Transmitters and Receivers/Narrowband_Receive_Array.md
text: 使用相控阵接收窄带辐射，输入 5 路、输出 1 路；按 {Geometry} 指定阵列几何结构；{Signal propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Operating frequency (Hz)} 指定系统工作频率 3e8、{Sensor gain measure} 指定传感器增益度量、{Enable weights input} 用于输入权重、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted、{Specify sensor array as} 指定阵列的方法 Array、{Element type} 指定阵列阵元类型 Isotropic、{Operating frequency range (Hz)} 指定天线或麦克风阵元的工作频率范围、{Operating frequency vector (Hz)} 指定自定义天线或麦克风阵元的工作频率范围、{Baffle the back of the element} 指定将 Isotropic Antenna 阵元或 Omni Microphone、{Exponent of cosine pattern} 指定方位角和俯仰角余弦方向图的指数、{Frequency responses (dB)} 指定天线和麦克风频率响应、{Input Pattern Coordinate System} 指定自定义天线方向图的坐标系、{Azimuth angles (deg)} 指定天线辐射方向图的方位角、{Elevation angles (deg)} 指定天线辐射方向图的俯仰角、{Phi Angles (deg)} 指定自定义天线辐射方向图的 Phi 角坐标 0:360、{Theta Angles (deg)} 指定自定义天线辐射方向图的 Theta 角坐标、{Magnitude pattern (dB)} 指定组合天线辐射方向图的幅值 zeros、{Phase pattern (deg)} 指定自定义天线辐射相位方向图 zeros、{MatchArrayNormal} 指定将天线阵元旋转到阵列法向、{Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)} 指定极性图麦克风响应频率 1e3、{Polar pattern angles (deg)} 指定极性图响应角度、{Polar pattern (dB)} 指定自定义麦克风极性响应 zeros、{Number of elements} 指定阵列阵元数 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA、{Element spacing (m)} 指定阵列阵元间距 0.5 for ULA arrays、{Array axis} 指定 ULA 的线性轴方向、{Array size} 指定 URA 阵列的维度、{Element lattice} 指定 URA 阵元位置的格点、{Array normal} 指定阵列法线方向 x for URA arrays or z for UCA、{Radius of UCA (m)} 指定 UCA 阵列半径、{Element positions (m)} 指定共形阵列阵元的位置、{Element normals (deg)} 指定共形阵列阵元法向量方向、{Taper} 指定阵列阵元渐削、{Subarray definition matrix} 定义属于子阵的元素 logical matrix、{Subarray steering method} 指定子阵导向方法、{Phase shifter frequency (Hz)} 指定子阵相移频率 3.0e8、{Number of bits in phase shifters} 指定子阵导向相移量化位数、{Subarrays layout} 指定子阵位置指定、{Grid size} 指定矩形子阵网格的维度、{Grid spacing (m)} 指定矩形网格上子阵之间的间距、{Subarray positions (m)} 指定子阵的位置、{Subarray normals} 指定子阵法向量的方向，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 入射信号 complex-valued M -by- L matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 入射信号方向 2 -by- 1 real-valued vector | 2 -by- L real-valued matrix

ports.name: W
ports.summary: 阵元或子阵权重 complex-valued P -by-1 vector

ports.name: WS
ports.summary: 子阵阵元权重 complex-valued N SE -by- L matrix

ports.name: Steer
ports.summary: 子阵指向角 real-valued length-2 column vector

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 收集的信号 complex-valued M -by- P matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Operating frequency (Hz)
params.values: 系统工作频率 3e8 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Sensor gain measure
params.values: 传感器增益度量 dB (default) | dBi

params.name: Enable weights input
params.values: 用于输入权重的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation

params.name: Specify sensor array as
params.values: 指定阵列的方法 Array (no subarrays) (default) | Partitioned array | Replicated subarray | MATLAB expression

params.name: Element type
params.values: 阵列阵元类型 Isotropic Antenna (default) | Cosine Antenna | Custom Antenna | Omni Microphone | Custom Microphone

params.name: Operating frequency range (Hz)
params.values: 天线或麦克风阵元的工作频率范围 [0,1e20] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 row vector

params.name: Operating frequency vector (Hz)
params.values: 自定义天线或麦克风阵元的工作频率范围 [0,1e20] (default) | real-valued row vector

params.name: Baffle the back of the element
params.values: 将 Isotropic Antenna 阵元或 Omni Microphone 阵元的后向响应设置为零 off (default) | on

params.name: Exponent of cosine pattern
params.values: 方位角和俯仰角余弦方向图的指数 [1.5 1.5] (default) | nonnegative scalar | real-valued 1-by-2 matrix of nonnegative values

params.name: Frequency responses (dB)
params.values: 天线和麦克风频率响应 [0,0] (default) | real-valued row vector

params.name: Input Pattern Coordinate System
params.values: 自定义天线方向图的坐标系 az-el (default) | phi-theta

params.name: Azimuth angles (deg)
params.values: 天线辐射方向图的方位角 [-180:180] (default) | real-valued row vector

params.name: Elevation angles (deg)
params.values: 天线辐射方向图的俯仰角 [-90:90] (default) | real-valued row vector

params.name: Phi Angles (deg)
params.values: 自定义天线辐射方向图的 Phi 角坐标 0:360 | real-valued 1-by- P row vector

params.name: Theta Angles (deg)
params.values: 自定义天线辐射方向图的 Theta 角坐标 0:180 | real-valued 1-by- Q row vector

params.name: Magnitude pattern (dB)
params.values: 组合天线辐射方向图的幅值 zeros(181,361) (default) | real-valued Q -by- P matrix | real-valued Q -by- P -by- L array

params.name: Phase pattern (deg)
params.values: 自定义天线辐射相位方向图 zeros(181,361) (default) | real-valued Q -by- P matrix | real-valued Q -by- P -by- L array

params.name: MatchArrayNormal
params.values: 将天线阵元旋转到阵列法向 on (default) | off

params.name: Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)
params.values: 极性图麦克风响应频率 1e3 (default) | real scalar | real-valued 1-by- L row vector

params.name: Polar pattern angles (deg)
params.values: 极性图响应角度 [-180:180] (default) | real-valued -by- P row vector

params.name: Polar pattern (dB)
params.values: 自定义麦克风极性响应 zeros(1,361) (default) | real-valued L -by- P matrix

params.name: Geometry
params.values: 阵列几何结构 ULA (default) | URA | UCA | Conformal Array

params.name: Number of elements
params.values: 阵列阵元数 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA arrays (default) | integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Element spacing (m)
params.values: 阵列阵元间距 0.5 for ULA arrays and [0.5,0.5] for URA arrays (default) | positive scalar for ULA or URA arrays | 2-element vector of positive values for URA arrays

params.name: Array axis
params.values: ULA 的线性轴方向 y (default) | x | z

params.name: Array size
params.values: URA 阵列的维度 [2,2] (default) | positive integer | 1-by-2 vector of positive integers

params.name: Element lattice
params.values: URA 阵元位置的格点 Rectangular (default) | Triangular

params.name: Array normal
params.values: 阵列法线方向 x for URA arrays or z for UCA arrays (default) | y

params.name: Radius of UCA (m)
params.values: UCA 阵列半径 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Element positions (m)
params.values: 共形阵列阵元的位置 [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by- N matrix of real values

params.name: Element normals (deg)
params.values: 共形阵列阵元法向量方向 [0;0] | 2-by-1 column vector | 2-by- N matrix

params.name: Taper
params.values: 阵列阵元渐削 1 (default) | complex-valued scalar | complex-valued row vector

params.name: Subarray definition matrix
params.values: 定义属于子阵的元素 logical matrix

params.name: Subarray steering method
params.values: 指定子阵导向方法 None (default) | Phase | Time

params.name: Phase shifter frequency (Hz)
params.values: 子阵相移频率 3.0e8 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Number of bits in phase shifters
params.values: 子阵导向相移量化位数 0 (default) | non-negative integer

params.name: Subarrays layout
params.values: 子阵位置指定 Rectangular (default) | Custom

params.name: Grid size
params.values: 矩形子阵网格的维度 [1,2] (default)

params.name: Grid spacing (m)
params.values: 矩形网格上子阵之间的间距 Auto (default) | positive real-valued scalar | 1-by-2 vector of positive real-values

params.name: Subarray positions (m)
params.values: 子阵的位置 [0,0;0.5,0.5;0,0] (default) | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

params.name: Subarray normals
params.values: 子阵法向量的方向 [0,0;0,0] (default) | 2-by- N real matrix
